Name: Yogi's Boomerangs
Author: yogiero
Description:
[i]Yogi’s Boomerangs[/i]
[heading]Short Summary[/heading]
Add four craftable returning boomerangs to Stardew Valley. Throw with left click, strike monsters on the way out and back.
[heading]Description[/heading]
Bring a new ranged weapon to the Valley with four craftable boomerang tiers. Aim with your cursor and throw with left click; each boomerang spins as it flies out, then returns to your farmer.
Boomerangs pass through walls, terrain, and objects. Each monster can be hit once on the outbound trip and once on the return trip. Hits use melee style weapon damage and show the usual floating damage numbers.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Four tiers: Bronze, Steel, Gold, and Iridium.[/*]
[*]Aim and throw in any direction with left click.[/*]
[*]Spinning flight on both the outbound and return paths.[/*]
[*]Passes through walls, terrain, and objects.[/*]
[*]Can hit monsters on both the outbound and return trips.[/*]
[*]Outbound hits apply modest knockback; return hits do not.[/*]
[*]Breaks sword-breakable map objects, including barrels and crates.[/*]
[*]Iridium can have two boomerangs active at once and grants +1 Movement Speed while held.[/*]
[*]Short launch, hit, and catch sounds; no continuous flight sound.[/*]
[/list][heading]Boomerang Stats[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Bronze:[/b] 22 damage, 10-tile range, +10% Critical Strike Chance.[/*]
[*][b]Steel:[/b] 30 damage, 10-tile range, +20% Critical Strike Chance.[/*]
[*][b]Gold:[/b] 50 damage, 10-tile range, +25% Critical Strike Chance.[/*]
[*][b]Iridium:[/b] 70 damage, 12-tile range, +50% Critical Strike Chance  +1 Movement Speed, and two active throws.[/*]
[/list][heading]Crafting[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Bronze Boomerang:[/b] 2 Copper Bars and 10 Wood — Combat level 1.[/*]
[*][b]Steel Boomerang:[/b] 2 Iron Bars and 5 Stone — Combat level 3.[/*]
[*][b]Gold Boomerang:[/b] 2 Gold Bars and 2 Omni Geodes — Combat level 6.[/*]
[*][b]Iridium Boomerang:[/b] 2 Iridium Bars and 2 Omni Geodes — Combat level 9.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer[/*]
[/list]Developed with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2. No other mods are required.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI if you haven’t already.[/*]
[*]Extract [b]Yogi’s Boomerangs 1.0.0.zip[/b] into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Confirm the extracted mod folder contains
[code]manifest.json[/code],
[code]Yogi’sBoomerangs.dll[/code], and the
[code]assets[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility and Notes[/heading]
The mod registers its weapons and crafting recipes through SMAPI. Mods that also change weapon or crafting-recipe data may affect compatibility.
The first release uses Stardew Valley’s short sword-use pose when throwing; it does not include a custom farmer throw animation.
